occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2025 Survey data, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2025 by January 15, 2026, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The operation did not have an Emergency medical form in the emergency binder for each child who is transported on the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers are missing first aid training. Current on in file expired 10.2022
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Two caregivers are missing 24 hours of training for the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: During the follow-up inspection, there is no infant feeding instruction sheet available for review at the operation for an infant that is not ready for table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There is no infant feeding instruction sheet available for review at the operation for an infant that is not ready for table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The operation's transportation van does not have a first aid kit on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Children were observed sleeping on nap mats that were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver has not completed 24 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: There is no infant daily report sheet available for review for an infant in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver employed does not have current training in pediatric first aid. The training expired on 3/13/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Five children age 3y to 4y old were left unsupervised in a classroom. The children were observed unsupervised during naptime.      Also, a 1 year old child was observed unsupervised in a classroom. The child was observed unsupervised during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The operation's transportation van does not have the child safety alarm installed on it. This van is being used to transport the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Observed the diaper changing mat in the infant room which contained rips/tears in it.     A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The Director does not have 2 hours in transportation training. The Director transports the school-age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Two children age 1 years old was observed watching a movie during the inspection.    Note: The caregiver turned off the television when prompted to do so.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The operation's transportation van does not have a fire extinguisher on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The Director has not completed 30 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation is missing the name and address of the alternate shelter away from the center you will use in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two outlet covers were missing from the outlets in the 2y to 3y old classroom.    Note: Corrected at inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: The operational policy is missing the safe sleep policy for infants 12 months and younger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There is no documentation that emergency drills are being practiced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver employed does not have current training in cpr. The training expired on 3/13/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant, age 1 years old was observed sleeping in a crib with a blanket, bib around their neck, and a pacifier with pacifier attachment.     A photo was taken.    Note: The caregiver removed the blanket, bib, and pacifier attachment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A 1 year old child was observed sitting in a high chair without the safety straps fastened.    Note: The caregiver fastened the straps when  prompted to do so.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Observed infant bottles/cups that were not labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children: An alternate activity or activities were not provided for two children age 1 years old who did not sleep during naptime.     Note: The caregiver gave the children activities when addressed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))
